body: We'll need to switch the prefix for `auc-` to `ais-`.

I'm guessing you're splitting this component for reuse later with other Recommend components, correct?

If yes, we might want to move them to a subdirectory to signal that they're not intended for any other usage.
Same question as for `DefaultHeader`.
There's a `packages/instantsearch-ui-components/src/types` directory where you can move these.

- For class names we usually provide JSDoc to help users know what each key refers to ([example](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/55d550eb1030a3b2091917b1a84d280a73a28a3a/packages/instantsearch-ui-components/src/components/Hits.tsx#L26-L43)).
- The type should be strict, and usage can use `Partial`.

We have a similar type in [`Hits.tsx`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/55d550eb1030a3b2091917b1a84d280a73a28a3a/packages/instantsearch-ui-components/src/components/Hits.tsx#L7-L9) that we could reuse.
Same comments as for `RecommendClassNames`.
There are several local types you've migrated and that are no longer used, but you're not getting type hinting because they're currently exported.
In InstantSearch we usually refer to this generic type as `THit`. I'd recommend renaming all `TObject` to `THit` for consistency.
Could this be spread directly in function parameters?
All comments apply to `ListView` as well when relevant.
I'll check if those are equivalent, my understanding is that `TObject` is the object without `objectID` and `_score`
Sure, however I followed the example in `Hits.tsx`  thinking it was the norm in this project
Hmm there might be a reason why we did this indeed, I recall some conversation with @Haroenv on that topic but can't remember why we did this.
I'd also add a test for the rendering of the default fallback component.
